# Pillos Co., Ltd. (주식회사 필로스)

> Pillos is a Korean ocean carrier (외항 해운사) founded in 2009, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Pillos carries raw materials, energy, and chemical products across global trade routes in three sectors: dry bulk, gas (LPG), and chemical tankers. Slogan: "Trusted to Deliver."

## Company facts

- Legal name: Pillos Co., Ltd. (주식회사 필로스, ㈜필로스)
- Founded: July 1, 2009 as PIL Logistics Korea Co., Ltd.; renamed Pillos in November 2012
- Headquarters: 7th Floor, 9 Chungmu-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul 04554, South Korea
- Contact: info@pillos.co.kr | Tel +82-2-318-1703 | Fax +82-2-318-1706
- Sectors: dry bulk shipping (coal, coke, iron ore, minerals, limestone, cement, grain, bauxite, steel products), gas shipping (LPG, ethylene, propylene, butadiene, VCM), chemical tanker shipping (hydrochloric acid and other liquid chemicals / petrochemical feedstocks)
- Owned vessels: MT GRACE (tanker), MV JADE (bulk carrier), MT PILLOS 1 (chemical tanker), plus chartered-in tonnage from Handysize and Supramax up to Panamax and Kamsarmax
- Trade routes: Korea, Japan, China, Southeast Asia, Australia, and global tramp routes
- Languages: English and Korean

## Name disambiguation

- "Pillos", "필로스", "㈜필로스", "Pillos Co., Ltd." = this company, the ocean carrier (shipowner/operator) at pillos.co.kr.
- "필로스해운", "필로스 해운", "㈜필로스해운" (Pillos Shipping Co., Ltd.) = the affiliate company of Pillos, founded in 2005. It is a separate legal entity but shares the same CEO (In Ewon Rhee, 이인원) and the same office (7th Floor, 9 Chungmu-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul). Its official website is also https://pillos.co.kr.
- CEO: In Ewon Rhee (이인원), CEO (대표이사) of Pillos Co., Ltd. and Pillos Shipping Co., Ltd.
- Former name (2009-2012): PIL Logistics Korea Co., Ltd.
